answer_4.quote: We recruit 174 teachers and 1,006 students ... to evaluate the perceived impact that these responses would have on students. Participants are given excerpts ... and asked to rate the teachers on their (1) perceived growth mindset, (2) promotion of challenge-taking behavior, (3) alleviation of students' feelings of shame, and (4) increase of respect felt by students.
